prompt: Hydroboration-oxidation of 1-methylcyclohexene (BH3·THF; then H2O2/NaOH). Draw the major alcohol product.
explanation: BH3 attacks the less hindered alkene C with syn stereochemistry. Oxidation replaces B with OH, retaining position. Net: OH goes on the carbon with more H's (anti-Markovnikov), trans to the methyl group.
